decisions.decision: Established repository-aware prompt system with .claude/ directory structure
decisions.rationale: Create systematic approach to maintain project context and coding consistency across sessions
decisions.impact: Future code changes will maintain consistency with established patterns and business domain

decisions.decision: Migrated to professional object-oriented architecture with modular package structure
decisions.rationale: Improve code maintainability, reusability, and enable better testing and extension. Original scripts were functional but not scalable for professional use.
alternatives_considered: Keep script-based approach with better organization
decisions.impact: Code is now more maintainable, testable, and follows enterprise patterns. Enables future features like strategy implementation and backtesting.

decisions.decision: Implemented configuration-driven parameter management with YAML
decisions.rationale: Enable easy parameter tuning without code changes, support different analysis scenarios, and provide validation for configuration values.
decisions.impact: Users can easily adjust analysis parameters, create different analysis profiles, and the Jupyter notebook can provide interactive parameter tuning.

decisions.decision: Created comprehensive Jupyter notebook interface with interactive widgets
decisions.rationale: Provide user-friendly interface for non-technical users, enable real-time parameter adjustment, and create step-by-step guided workflow for complex analysis.
decisions.impact: Makes the system accessible to business users, provides interactive parameter tuning, and serves as comprehensive documentation of the analysis process.

learnings.learning: Professional architecture enables better maintainability and extensibility
learnings.details: Object-oriented design with proper separation of concerns makes the codebase more maintainable and easier to extend with new features
learnings.application: Use class-based components with clear interfaces and dependency injection for future development

learnings.learning: Configuration management is critical for parameter-heavy quantitative analysis
learnings.details: Financial analysis involves many parameters that need tuning. Centralized configuration with validation prevents errors and enables easy experimentation
learnings.application: Always use configuration-driven approach for quantitative systems with parameter validation

learnings.learning: User experience is crucial for adoption of quantitative tools
learnings.details: Interactive Jupyter notebooks with widgets make complex analysis accessible to business users and enable real-time parameter experimentation
learnings.application: Provide user-friendly interfaces for technical tools to increase adoption

learnings.learning: Memory management is essential for large financial datasets
learnings.details: COTAHIST files are >50MB and require careful memory management. Chunked processing and caching prevent memory issues
learnings.application: Always consider memory efficiency when processing large financial datasets
